mass long_ground_size = scale(global_pose, vector=[2.3, 0.8, 0.8])

mass assembly_1 = union(long_ground_position, return_wall_position)

mass upper_counterwing_position = translate(upper_counterwing_rotation, vector=[0.12, 0.48, 1.375])
mass assembly_2 = union(assembly_1, upper_counterwing_position)
